source_note: A common tip: have the agent write a checklist file and tick it off as it works. With: the prefix asks for TASKS.md, a checkbox list of every step including build and test runs, worked in order and ticked in the file, finishing only when every box is ticked. Without: the task text only. Claude Code's built-in task tracking stays on for both sides. Extra measure: boxes ticked vs left open in TASKS.md at the end. Graders ignore a new file at the repo root.

with.label: TASKS.md checklist, ticked as it works
with.prompt_prefix: Before changing code, write TASKS.md: a checkbox list of every step this task needs, including build and test runs. Work through it in order and tick each box in the file as you finish it. Finish only when every box is ticked.
